Let  

\[
\sqrt[20]{x^{\log_{2026}x}} = 26x ,\qquad x>0 .
\]

Raise both sides to the 20th power:

\[
x^{\log_{2026}x} = (26x)^{20}=26^{20}x^{20}.
\]

Divide by \(x^{20}\) (since \(x>0\)):

\[
x^{\log_{2026}x-20}=26^{20}.
\]

Take \(\log_{2026}\) of both sides and set \(u=\log_{2026}x\):

\[
(u-20)u = 20\log_{2026}26\quad\Longrightarrow\quad u^{2}-20u-20\log_{2026}26=0 .
\]

This quadratic has two real roots \(u_1,u_2\).  
By Vieta’s formulas,

\[
u_1+u_2 = 20 .
\]

Since \(x=2026^{\,u}\), the two positive solutions are \(x_1=2026^{u_1}\) and \(x_2=2026^{u_2}\).  
Their product is

\[
x_1x_2 = 2026^{\,u_1+u_2}=2026^{20}.
\]

Factor \(2026\):

\[
2026 = 2\cdot 1013,
\]

and \(1013\) is prime. Hence

\[
2026^{20}=2^{20}\cdot 1013^{20}.
\]

The number of positive divisors of a number \(p^{a}q^{b}\) is \((a+1)(b+1)\).  
Thus

\[
d(2026^{20}) = (20+1)(20+1)=21^2 = 441.
\]

\[
\boxed{441}
\]
